_doc: Every tenant declares where its data comes from at creation (create_customer data_origin=…) and the platform discloses it on every surface (portfolio, journey, Ask AI, /health, backtest). Only 'real' earns a 'measured' label. Changing it later is an audited action (declare_data_origin).

real.label: Customer data
real.disclosure: Real customer data. Results are measurements of this tenant's own history.

synthetic_demo.label: Synthetic demo data
synthetic_demo.disclosure: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA: this tenant was generated from a manifest to show the mechanism. Lead times, scores and outcomes are authored, not observed. Nothing here is a measurement of a real customer.

synthetic_replay.label: Replay of historical data
synthetic_replay.disclosure: REPLAY: this tenant re-plays exported historical data through the current pipeline for parity checks. Treat every number as a replay, not a live measurement.

synthetic_test.label: Test fixture
synthetic_test.disclosure: TEST FIXTURE: created by an automated test.
